about: Alchemy Labs Inc. operates as a nanotechnology company that engages in researching, developing, and commercializing protective nanocomposite coatings for the automotive and defense markets worldwide. It develops a range of windshield protection film and paint protection film products for the automotive industry. It also engages in commercializing thermal signature management solutions for the defense industry using its TSM Platform. The company's automotive division offers a range of windshield protection film and paint protection film products under the ExoShield tradename. Its defense unit products are marketed under the Crypsis tradename focusing on commercializing nanoparticle-based thermal signature management solutions for the defense industry. Its windshield protection products include ExoShield GT3+, a PET based film; ExoShield Ultra for vehicle specific windshields including heavy duty glass; and ExoShield Sprint, a TPU based film designed for weekend drivers and specialty track vehicles. The company's paint protection products include ExoShield Mach 12 and ExoShield Mach S for professional installation. Additionally, the company provides training services and support services. The company's defense solutions division, Crypsis Class, focuses on commercializing nanoparticle-based TSM solutions for use in the defense industry and manufacturing processes and substrates, including textiles, paints and films. Its Crypsis coatings are used across a broad range of applications, such as coated textiles, including ponchos, uniforms, rain gear, winter wear, tents, bags and boots; paints and sprays, including face paints and paint coatings on weapons systems and vehicles; and films and laminates, for use on windows, windshields, sensor housings and vehicle bodies. The company was formerly known as Lawson West Capital Inc. and changed its name to Alchemy Labs Inc. in December 2022. Alchemy Labs Inc. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Kitchener, Canada.
